sentences.en: Do I look too fat to you? Well, that's subjective.
sentences.zh: 你觉得我看起来太胖了吗？那可就说不准了，这挺主观的。

sentences.en: Subjective reality is whatever the hell I want it to be.
sentences.zh: 主观现实就是我想要的样子。

sentences.en: Marilla was not given to subjective analysis of her thoughts and feelings.
sentences.zh: 马里亚尔不太喜欢对自己的想法和感受进行主观分析。
